title: Mass Career Customization
description: Far-reaching changes in attitudes and family structures have been redefining the workforce for more than two decadesyet the workplace has remained much the same. During this time, many companies have learned that personalizing the customer experience is good for business. In Mass Career Customization, the authors argue convincingly to extend this popular and profitable concept to the workplace.This book is centered on the powerful insight that career options in today’s economy need to accommodate the rising and falling phases of employee engagement as it changes over time. The remarkable process unveiled in this book offers choices involving four important dimensions of career progression: role; pace; location and schedule; and workload.As the working population shrinks, maintaining industry advantage will depend largely on keeping employees engaged and connected. Mass career customization provides a framework for organizational adaptability that will do just that.
translatedDescription: Los cambios de las actitudes y las estructuras familiares de gran alcance han ido redefiniendo la fuerza de trabajo durante más de dos décadas; sin embargo, el lugar de trabajo ha permanecido mucho igual. Durante este tiempo, muchas empresas han aprendido que la personalización de la experiencia del cliente es buena para los negocios. En Mass Career Customization, los autores argumentan convincentemente extender este concepto popular y rentable al lugar de trabajo. Este libro se centra en la poderosa visión de que las opciones de carrera en la economía actual necesitan acomodar las fases crecientes y caídas del compromiso de los empleados a medida que cambia con el tiempo. El notable proceso que se presenta en este libro ofrece opciones que implican cuatro importantes dimensiones de la progresión profesional: función; ritmo; ubicación y calendario; y volumen de trabajo. A medida que la población trabajadora se encoge, mantener la ventaja de la industria dependerá en gran medida de mantener a los empleados comprometidos y conectados. La personalización de la carrera en masa proporciona un marco para la adaptabilidad organizativa que hará exactamente eso.

title: Orientalism, Gender, and the Jews
description: Originating in the collaboration of the international Research Network “Gender in Antisemitism, Orientalism and Occidentalism” (RENGOO), this collection of essays proposes to intervene in current debates about historical constructions of Jewish identity in relation to colonialism and Orientalism. The network‌’s collaborative research addresses imaginative and aesthetic rather than sociological questions with particular focus on the function of gender and sexuality in literary, scholarly and artistic transformations of Orientalist images. RENGOO’s first publication explores the ways in which stereotypes of the external and internal Other intertwine. With its interrogation of the roles assumed in this interplay by gender, processes of sexualization, and aesthetic formations, the volume suggests new directions to the interdisciplinary study of gender, antisemitism, and Orientalism.
translatedDescription: Originaria de la Red Internacional de Investigación “Gender in Antisemitism, Orientalism and Occidentalism” (RENGOO), esta colección de ensayos propone intervenir en debates actuales sobre construcciones históricas de identidad judía en relación con el colonialismo y el orientalismo. La investigación colaborativa de la red aborda cuestiones imaginativas y estéticas más que sociológicas, con especial atención a la función del género y la sexualidad en transformaciones literarias, académicas y artísticas de imágenes orientalistas. La primera publicación de RENGOO explora las formas en que los estereotipos de los otros interrelacionados externos e internos. Con su interrogatorio de los roles asumidos en esta interacción por género, procesos de sexualización y formaciones estéticas, el volumen sugiere nuevas direcciones al estudio interdisciplinario de género, antisemitismo y Orientalismo.

title: Rapport and the Discursive Co-Construction of Social Relations in Fieldwork Encounters
description: In accounts of ethnographic fieldwork and textbooks on ethnography, we often find the notion of rapport used to describe social relationships in the field. Frequently, rapport between researcher and researched is invoked as a prerequisite to be achieved before fieldwork can start, or used as evidence to judge the value and robustness of an ethnography. With few exceptions, and despite regular pleas to do so, ethnographers continue to avoid presenting any discursive evidence of what rapport might look like from an interactional perspective. In a sense, the uncritical acceptance of rapport as a fieldwork goal and measure has helped hide the discursive work that goes on in the field. In turn, this has privileged ideas about identity as portable rather than “portable and emergent”, and reports of social life as more important than how such reports emerge. Written for all those who engage or plan to engage in ethnographic fieldwork, this collection examines how social relationships dialogically emerge in fieldwork settings.
translatedDescription: En relatos de trabajo etnográfico y libros de texto sobre etnografía, a menudo encontramos la noción de rapport utilizada para describir las relaciones sociales en el campo. Con frecuencia, el rapport entre investigador e investigador se invoca como requisito previo para ser alcanzado antes de que el trabajo de campo pueda comenzar, o se utiliza como evidencia para juzgar el valor y la robustez de una etnografía. Con pocas excepciones, y a pesar de las súplicas regulares para hacerlo, los etnógrafos continúan evitando presentar cualquier evidencia discursiva de lo que el rapport puede parecer desde una perspectiva interaccional. En cierto sentido, la aceptación no crítica del rapport como objetivo y medida de trabajo sobre el terreno ha ayudado a ocultar el trabajo discursivo que continúa en el campo. A su vez, esto tiene ideas privilegiadas sobre la identidad como portátil en lugar de “portable e emergente”, e informes de la vida social como más importante que cómo emergen esos informes. Escrito para todos aquellos que se involucran o planean participar en el campo etnográfico, esta colección examina cómo las relaciones sociales emergen dialógicamente en los ajustes de trabajo de campo.

title: Nonprofits as Policy Solutions to the Burden of Government
description:
This book addresses a specific subset of nonprofits that are chartered with a single mission: decrease the burden of government. Designing and engaging nonprofits to lessen the burden of government requires a specific description and acknowledgement of the burden to be lessened, and these may include the provision of infrastructure, the relief of debt, or the provision of general public services that are not motivated by charity. It also requires the assignment of specific operating powers to the nonprofit including the power of eminent domain. This book explores these and other related topics including the avoidance of resource dependence on government when attempting to reduce its burden.

The book is addressed to the policy makers and rule makers who design policies that affect the ability of the nonprofit to effectively lessen the burden of government. It is also addressed to public administrators in search of innovative ways of implementing these policies consistent with the laws, and to the creative nonprofit managers who are charged with carrying out the mission often in collaboration with the government or other entities. To the advanced student in all related fields, the author offers not only material for discussion, but enables discovery of what is possible by giving key examples of organizations meeting the terms and objective of lessening a significant burden of government.
translatedDescription:
Este libro aborda un subconjunto específico de organizaciones sin fines de lucro que son fletadas con una sola misión: disminuir la carga del gobierno. El diseño y la participación de las organizaciones sin fines de lucro para reducir la carga del gobierno requiere una descripción específica y el reconocimiento de la carga que debe reducirse, y esto puede incluir la provisión de infraestructura, el alivio de la deuda, o la prestación de servicios públicos generales que no están motivados por la caridad. También requiere la asignación de poderes operativos específicos a la organización sin fines de lucro, incluyendo el poder de dominio eminente. Este libro explora estos y otros temas relacionados, incluyendo la evitación de la dependencia de recursos del gobierno al intentar reducir su carga.

El libro está dirigido a los responsables de la formulación de políticas y a los gobernantes que diseñan políticas que afectan la capacidad de la organización sin fines de lucro para reducir eficazmente la carga del gobierno. También se dirige a los administradores públicos en busca de formas innovadoras de aplicar estas políticas de conformidad con las leyes, y a los administradores creativos sin fines de lucro encargados de llevar a cabo la misión a menudo en colaboración con el gobierno u otras entidades. Para el estudiante avanzado en todas las esferas conexas, el autor ofrece no sólo material para el debate, sino que permite descubrir lo que es posible dando ejemplos clave de organizaciones que cumplen los términos y el objetivo de reducir una carga significativa del gobierno.

title: Why Best Practices Often Fall Short

Readers will gain vital and accurate knowledge about the music business, how musicians get paid, the legal framework for business, and will learn to recognize and leverage opportunities through overcoming the inevitable obstacles to success in a rapidly-changing industry.

The author offers valuable insights into the niche readers might fill with their career, and discover their unique path to success. Readers will come away with a greater understanding of the scope and demands of the music and entertainment industry.

title: Post-Tsunami Reconstruction in Indonesia
description:
This book offers a critical analysis of gender mainstreaming initiatives in the post-tsunami context in Indonesia. Aiming to challenge the terms of the debate in gender mainstreaming and disaster reconstruction efforts, Jauhola offers an important contribution for the discussion of what ‘feminisms and disasters’ could be. The work provides an in-depth analysis of three governmental practices of gender mainstreaming: the use of the concept pair sex/gender; the use of gender analysis and the use of project management tools and local subversion that challenges the potential normative violence of gender mainstreaming.

Providing feminist intersectional reading of gender mainstreaming the book aims to illustrate that this framework does not lack political alternatives, but rather, it offers an alternative focus for feminism and for the re-conceptualisation of ‘political’, and provides tools for practitioners of aid aiming to come to grips with the complexity of gender equality policy agenda and its potential violent social consequences in global politics.

Drawing on extensive field research in Aceh, this text is one of the first book length studies, and thus provides a significant addition to Indonesian literatures on intersectional analysis of gender, religion, heteronormativity, and feminist subversive practice. It is a vital resource for those interested in understanding global interconnections of localised disaster and conflict reconstruction.
translatedDescription:
Este libro ofrece un análisis crítico de las iniciativas de incorporación de la perspectiva de género en el contexto posterior al tsunami en Indonesia. Con el fin de desafiar los términos del debate en la incorporación de la perspectiva de género y los esfuerzos de reconstrucción en casos de desastre, Jauhola ofrece una importante contribución para el debate sobre lo que podrían ser los ‘feminismos y desastres’. La labor proporciona un análisis a fondo de tres prácticas gubernamentales de incorporación de la perspectiva de género: el uso del concepto par sexo/género; el uso del análisis de género y el uso de instrumentos de gestión de proyectos y la subversión local que desafía la posible violencia normativa de la incorporación de la perspectiva de género.

Proporcionar lectura interseccional feminista de la incorporación de la perspectiva de género el libro pretende ilustrar que este marco no carece de alternativas políticas, sino que ofrece un enfoque alternativo para el feminismo y para la re-conceptualización de la ‘política’, y proporciona herramientas para que los profesionales de la ayuda se adapten a la complejidad de la agenda política de igualdad de género y sus posibles consecuencias sociales violentas en la política global.

Basándose en extensas investigaciones de campo en Aceh, este texto es uno de los primeros estudios de longitud de libro, y por lo tanto proporciona una adición significativa a las literaturas indonesias sobre el análisis interseccional de género, religión, heteronormatividad y práctica subversiva feminista. Es un recurso vital para aquellos interesados en comprender las interconexiones mundiales de desastres localizados y reconstrucción de conflictos.

title: UI is Communication
description:
User interface design is a challenging, multi-disciplinary activity that requires understanding a wide range of concepts and techniques that are often subjective and even conflicting. Imagine how much it would help if there were a single perspective that you could use to simplify these complex issues down to a small set of objective principles. In UI is Communication, Everett McKay explains how to design intuitive user interfaces by focusing on effective human communication. A user interface is ultimately a conversation between users and technology. Well-designed user interfaces use the language of UI to communicate to users efficiently and naturally. They also recognize that there is an emotional human being at the other end of the interaction, so good user interfaces strive to make an emotional connection. Applying what you learn from UI is Communication will remove much of the mystic, subjectiveness, and complexity from user interface design, and help you make better design decisions with confidence. It’s the perfect introduction to user interface design.

Approachable, practical communication-based guide to interaction and visual design that you can immediately apply to projects to make solid design decisions quickly and confidently
Includes design makeovers so you can see the concepts in practice with real examples
Communication-based design process ties everything from interaction to visual design together

En UI es Comunicación, Everett McKay explica cómo diseñar interfaces de usuario intuitivas centrándose en una comunicación humana efectiva. Una interfaz de usuario es en última instancia una conversación entre usuarios y tecnología. Las interfaces de usuario bien diseñadas utilizan el lenguaje de la interfaz de usuario para comunicarse a los usuarios de manera eficiente y natural. También reconocen que hay un ser humano emocional en el otro extremo de la interacción, por lo que las buenas interfaces de usuario se esfuerzan por hacer una conexión emocional. Aplicar lo que usted aprende de la interfaz de usuario es Comunicación eliminará gran parte del místico, subjetivo y complejidad del diseño de la interfaz de usuario, y le ayudará a tomar mejores decisiones de diseño con confianza. title: A Guide to IT Contracting
description:
Even leading organizations with sophisticated IT infrastructures and teams of lawyers can find themselves unprepared to deal with the range of issues that can arise in IT contracting. Written by two seasoned attorneys, A Guide to IT Contracting: Checklists, Tools, and Techniques distills the most critical business and legal lessons learned through the authors’ decades of experience drafting and negotiating IT-related agreements.In a single volume, readers can quickly access information on virtually every type of technology agreement. Structured to focus on a particular type of IT agreement, each chapter includes a checklist of essential terms, a brief summary of what the agreement is intended to do, and a complete review of the legal and business issues that are addressed in that particular agreement. Providing non-legal professionals with the tools to address IT contracting issues, the book:

Contains checklists to help readers organize key concepts for ready reference
Supplies references to helpful online resources and aids for contract drafting
Includes downloadable resources with reusable checklists and complete glossary that defines key legal, business, and technical terms

Costly mistakes can be avoided, risk can be averted, and better contracts can be drafted if you have access to the right information. Filled with reader-friendly checklists, this accessible reference will set you down that path. Warning you of the most common pitfalls, it arms you with little-known tips and best practices to help you negotiate the key terms of your IT agreements with confidence and ensure you come out on top in your next contract negotiation.

Incluye recursos descargables con listas de verificación reutilizables y glosario completo que define términos jurídicos, empresariales y técnicos clave

Se pueden evitar errores costosos, evitar el riesgo, y se pueden redactar mejores contratos si tiene acceso a la información correcta. Repleto de listas de verificación amigables con el lector, esta referencia accesible te establecerá por ese camino. Advirtiendote en los obstáculos más comunes, te arma con consejos poco conocidos y mejores prácticas para ayudarte a negociar los términos clave de tus acuerdos de TI con confianza y asegurarte de que salgas arriba en tu próxima negociación de contrato.

title: Executive's Guide to IT Governance: Improving Systems Processes with Service Management, COBIT, and ITIL
description:
Create strong IT governance processes

In the current business climate where a tremendous amount of importance is being given to governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), the concept of IT governance is becoming an increasingly strong component. Executive's Guide to IT Governance explains IT governance, why it is important to general, financial, and IT managers, along with tips for creating a strong governance, risk, and compliance IT systems process.

Written by Robert Moeller, an authority in auditing and IT governance

Practical, no-nonsense framework for identifying, planning, delivering, and supporting IT services to your business

Helps you identify current strengths and weaknesses of your enterprise IT governance processes

Explores how to introduce effective IT governance principles with other enterprise GRC initiatives

Other titles by Robert Moeller: IT Audit, Control, and Security and Brink's Modern Internal Auditing: A Common Body of Knowledge

There is strong pressure on corporations to have a good understanding of their IT systems and the controls that need to be in place to avoid such things as fraud and security violations. Executive's Guide to IT Governance gives you the tools you need to improve systems processes through IT service management, COBIT, and ITIL.
translatedDescription:
Crear procesos de gobernanza de TI fuertes

En el actual clima empresarial en el que se da una enorme importancia a la gobernanza, el riesgo y el cumplimiento (GRC), el concepto de gobernanza de TI se está convirtiendo en un componente cada vez más fuerte. La Guía Ejecutiva para la Gobernanza de TI explica la gobernanza de TI, por qué es importante para los gerentes generales, financieros y de TI, junto con consejos para crear un sólido proceso de gobernanza, riesgo y cumplimiento de los sistemas de TI.

Escrito por Robert Moeller, una autoridad en auditoría y gobernanza de TI

Marco práctico y sin sentido para identificar, planificar, entregar y apoyar los servicios de TI a su negocio

Le ayuda a identificar las fortalezas y debilidades actuales de sus procesos de gobernanza de TI empresarial

Explores how to introduce effective IT governance principles with other enterprise GRC initiatives

Otros títulos de Robert Moeller: Auditoría de TI, Control y Seguridad y Auditoría Interna Moderna de Brink: Un Cuerpo Común de Conocimiento

Hay una fuerte presión sobre las empresas para que tengan una buena comprensión de sus sistemas informáticos y de los controles que necesitan para evitar cosas como fraude y violaciones de seguridad. La Guía Ejecutiva para la Gobernanza de TI le da las herramientas que necesita para mejorar los procesos de sistemas a través de la gestión de servicios de TI, COBIT y ITIL.

title: The Definitive Guide to Inventory Management: Principles and Strategies for the Efficient Flow of Inventory across the Supply Chain
description:
Master and apply both the technical and behavioral skills you need to succeed in any inventory management role or function! Now, there’s an authoritative and comprehensive guide to best-practice inventory management in any organization. Authored by world-class experts in collaboration with the Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP), this text illuminates planning, organizing, controlling, directing, motivating and coordinating all the activities used to efficiently control product flow. The Definitive Guide to Inventory Management covers long-term strategic decisions; mid-term tactical decisions; and even short-term operational decisions. Topics discussed include:

Basic inventory management goals, roles, concepts, purposes, and terminology

Key inventory management elements, processes, and interactions

Principles/strategies for establishing efficient and effective inventory flows

Using technology in inventory planning and management

New approaches to inventory reduction: postponement, vendor-managed inventories, cross-docking, and quick response systems

Trade-offs between inventory and transportation costs, including carrying costs

Requirements and challenges of global inventory management

Best practices, metrics, and frameworks for assessing inventory management performance
translatedDescription:
Máster y aplicar tanto las habilidades técnicas y conductuales que usted necesita para tener éxito en cualquier rol o función de gestión del inventario! Ahora, hay una guía autorizada e integral para la gestión de inventarios de mejor práctica en cualquier organización. Autorizado por expertos de clase mundial en colaboración con el Consejo de Profesionales de Gestión de Cadenas de Suministros (CSCMP), este texto ilumina la planificación, organización, control, dirección, motivación y coordinación de todas las actividades utilizadas para controlar eficientemente el flujo de productos. La Guía definitiva para la gestión de los inventarios abarca decisiones estratégicas a largo plazo; decisiones tácticas a mediano plazo; e incluso decisiones operacionales a corto plazo. Los temas tratados incluyen:

Objetivos básicos de gestión de inventarios, funciones, conceptos, propósitos y terminología

Principales elementos, procesos e interacciones de gestión de inventarios

Principios y estrategias para establecer corrientes de inventario eficientes y eficaces

Utilización de la tecnología en la planificación y gestión de inventarios

Nuevos enfoques para la reducción del inventario: aplazamiento, inventarios gestionados por proveedores, sistemas de control cruzado y respuesta rápida

Cambios entre los costos de inventario y transporte, incluidos los costos de transporte

Requisitos y retos de la gestión mundial de los inventarios

Buenas prácticas, métricas y marcos para evaluar el desempeño de la gestión de inventarios

title: Mastering ServiceNow - Second Edition
description:
"Mastering ServiceNow" is your comprehensive guide to unlocking the full capabilities of the ServiceNow platform. This engaging and hands-on resource, updated for the Helsinki version, covers everything from building custom applications to designing secure workflows, helping you gain expertise in application development and system management within ServiceNow.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamentals of the ServiceNow platform and its architecture.
Develop customized, secure, and automated workflow applications.
Create a responsive self-service interface using Service Portal.
Integrate data with external systems via RESTful APIs and secure web services.
Implement advanced enterprise-level solutions with efficient client-side scripting.

Author(s)

None Wood is a seasoned expert in ServiceNow architectures and development, with years of experience in guiding professionals to effectively leverage the platform for enterprise solutions. Known for a clear and practical writing style, None simplifies complex topics, empowering readers to gain both theoretical and hands-on knowledge.

Who is it for?

This book is aimed at intermediate to advanced professionals seeking to enhance their skills in the ServiceNow platform. You are likely a system administrator or developer with basic knowledge of JavaScript and web technology. If you're driven to deepen your understanding and create impactful ServiceNow solutions, this book is for you.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender los fundamentos de la plataforma ServiceNow y su arquitectura.
Desarrollar aplicaciones de flujo de trabajo personalizadas, seguras y automatizadas.

Integrar datos con sistemas externos a través de API RESTful y servicios web seguros.
Implementar soluciones avanzadas de nivel empresarial con scripting eficiente de lado cliente.

title: Microsoft IIS 10.0 Cookbook
description:
"Microsoft IIS 10.0 Cookbook" is a comprehensive guide for anyone looking to maximize the potential of Microsoft's IIS 10.0 web server by using real-world, task-oriented recipes. This book provides practical, step-by-step instructions for setting up, configuring, and managing IIS on various operating systems and environments.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and implement IIS 10.0 integration with Windows Server 2016.
Host and manage multiple websites using IIS 10.0's versatile features.
Deploy IIS 10.0 in a Nano Server environment for improved efficiency.
Use PowerShell cmdlets for effective IIS 10.0 administration.
Troubleshoot and secure IIS 10.0 to ensure reliable operations.

Author(s)

None Khan is an expert in web server technologies with extensive experience in administering and deploying IIS environments. They have guided numerous IT professionals through practical, hands-on guidance in the use of IIS in both small-scale and enterprise environments. Their approach to teaching is highly practical and focused on solving real-world scenarios that administrators face.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for system administrators, IT professionals, and web developers who are either new to IIS or looking to enhance their knowledge of the IIS 10.0 ecosystem. Those with basic to advanced understanding of IT systems can benefit from its practical hands-on recipes and solutions. It's particularly suitable for those managing Windows-based hosting environments and aiming at mastering IIS administration.

Host y gestiona múltiples sitios web usando las funciones versátiles de IIS 10.0.

Es especialmente adecuado para aquellos que administran entornos de alojamiento basados en Windows y apuntan a dominar la administración IIS.

title: The iPhone Photography Book
description:
Learn to take great photos with your iPhone—the camera you always have with you!

This is it—the long-awaited book fully dedicated to iPhone photography by photographer and bestselling author Scott Kelby! In this book, Scott brings his award-winning approach of sharing his secrets and shooting advice just like he would with a friend if they were out shooting together. Each page covers a single technique, tool, or trick you can use to capture truly amazing pictures with your iPhone.

You’ll learn how to get great shots in low light, how to capture awesome portraits of people, how to nail your composition, and how to take jaw-dropping travel, food, and landscape photos. You’ll learn all about time lapse photography, long exposure, and panoramas. You’ll find out just what accessories you really need, and you’ll learn some cool post-processing tricks. And, of course, Scott covers the best tips and tricks for shooting with your iPhone, as well as the top 10 photo apps he uses that will make your images better and make shooting with your iPhone that much more fun.

Cada página cubre una sola técnica, herramienta o truco que puede utilizar para capturar imágenes realmente sorprendentes con su iPhone.

title: ITIL4 CDS (Create, Deliver and Support: Reference and Study Guide)
description: The ITIL 4 Create, Deliver and Support (CDS) reference and revision guide is one of five ITIL 4 revision aids published by TSO, following on from the ITIL 4 Foundation revision guide. It summarizes the ‘core’ IT service management activities and focuses on the co-creation of value with the customer through leadership, team structure learning and incremental improvement. Key topics include planning and building service value streams, understanding key management requirements, plus how to create, deliver and support services. It will enable IT practitioners to deliver innovative reliable IT services and improve their quality of service. This pocket guide is an aid for revision and preparation for taking the ITIL 4 Managing Professional: CDS certification, and post-certification it is a quick useful reference. It summarizes key topics for exam preparation, includes key figures from the core guidance, provides an examination overview, tips for taking the exam and a summary table linking learning outcomes to references in the text and to core guidance.
translatedDescription: La guía de referencia y revisión ITIL 4 Create, Deliver and Support (CDS) es una de las cinco ayudas de revisión ITIL 4 publicadas por TSO, siguiendo la guía de revisión de la Fundación ITIL 4. Resume las actividades de gestión de servicios de TI ‘core’ y se centra en la co-creación de valor con el cliente a través del liderazgo, el aprendizaje de estructura de equipo y la mejora incremental. Los temas clave incluyen la planificación y construcción de corrientes de valor de servicio, la comprensión de los requisitos clave de gestión, además de cómo crear, ofrecer y apoyar servicios. Permitirá a los profesionales de la TI ofrecer servicios innovadores de TI fiables y mejorar su calidad de servicio. Esta guía de bolsillo es una ayuda para la revisión y preparación para tomar el ITIL 4 Managing Professional: certificación CDS, y post-certificación es una referencia útil rápida. En él se resumen los temas clave para la preparación del examen, se incluyen figuras clave de la orientación básica, se ofrece una visión general del examen, consejos para tomar el examen y una tabla sumaria que vincula los resultados del aprendizaje a las referencias en el texto y a la orientación básica.

title: ITIL4 Digital and IT Strategy: Reference and Study Guide
description: The ITIL 4 Digital IT and Strategy (DITS) reference and revision guide is one of five ITIL 4 revision aids published by TSO, following on from ITIL 4 Foundation revision guide. It focuses on the alignment of digital business strategy with IT strategy. It also covers how disruption from new technologies is impacting organizations and how businesses are responding. Key topics include, using DITS in an organization, DITS and digital disruption, strategic approaches for digital organizations, implementing DITS and ITIL practices in DITS. This pocket guide is an aid for revision and preparation for taking the ITIL 4 Managing Professional: DITS certification, and post-certification it is a quick useful reference. It summarizes key topics for exam preparation, includes key figures from the core guidance, provides an examination overview, tips for taking the exam and a summary table linking learning outcomes to references in the text and to core guidance.

Se centra en la alineación de la estrategia de negocio digital con la estrategia de TI. También abarca cómo la perturbación de las nuevas tecnologías afecta a las organizaciones y cómo responden las empresas. Los temas clave incluyen, utilizando DITS en una organización, DITS y trastorno digital, enfoques estratégicos para las organizaciones digitales, implementando DITS y prácticas ITIL en DITS. Esta guía de bolsillo es una ayuda para la revisión y preparación para tomar el ITIL 4 Managing Professional: certificación DITS, y post-certificación es una referencia útil rápida. En él se resumen los temas clave para la preparación del examen, se incluyen figuras clave de la orientación básica, se ofrece una visión general del examen, consejos para tomar el examen y una tabla sumaria que vincula los resultados del aprendizaje a las referencias en el texto y a la orientación básica.

title: ITIL 4 Digital and IT Strategy (DITS) - Your companion to the ITIL 4 Strategic Leader DITS certification
description:
This guide contains everything you need to know to pass the ITIL 4® Strategic Leader Digital and IT Strategy certificate, plus more.

 

It covers practices and concepts that are not addressed as part of the DITS syllabus, making it ideal for newly qualified practitioners.

 

The target audience for the DITS training and associated certification is different to some of the other ITIL training courses. The material is specifically aimed at:

 

IT and business directors;
Department heads;
C-suite professionals;
Leaders who are involved in digital change; and
Consultants who are working with organisations that are digitally transforming.

 

So, if you’re not in a senior role, does that mean this content isn’t for you? Absolutely not! Perhaps you aspire to a more senior role, in which case you’ll gain valuable knowledge.

Ideal for self-study candidates and training participants, this guide will prove a helpful companion and a practical aid for their professional development.

The majority of this book is based on the official ITIL 4: Digital and IT Strategic Leader publication and the associated DITS syllabus. It provides students with the information they need to pass the DITS exam and help them become a successful practitioner.

 

ITIL® is a registered trade mark of the PeopleCert group. Used under licence from PeopleCert. All rights reserved.

title: IT Audit Field Manual
description:
IT Audit Field Manual provides a comprehensive guide for IT professionals aiming to enhance their cybersecurity practices through effective auditing. Written by an experienced auditor with an extensive background in IT and cybersecurity, the manual offers in-depth insights, practical tools, and detailed walkthroughs to help readers audit systems effectively and ensure compliance with regulations.

What this Book will help me do

Gain expertise in auditing cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
Learn to conduct thorough risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities.
Master compliance standards auditing, covering GDPR, HIPAA, SOX, and more.
Develop skills in auditing network devices, Linux/Windows systems, and endpoints.
Understand career progression in IT auditing and essential tools and methodologies.

Author(s)

Lewis Heuermann, with over a decade of military and IT auditing experience, brings unique expertise to this field manual. His approach combines technical depth with actionable strategies. Lewis aims to bridge the gap between fundamental understanding and advanced professional know-how, providing a clear pathway for career advancement in IT auditing.

Who is it for?

This book is geared towards IT professionals new to auditing or with early career experience, who seek to develop practical, actionable auditing skills. It provides a solid foundation while escalating into more advanced concepts, making it suitable for learners aiming to enter or excel in IT auditing roles and work on complex infrastructures.
translatedDescription:
El Manual de Auditoría de TI proporciona una guía integral para los profesionales de la TI con el fin de mejorar sus prácticas de seguridad cibernética mediante una auditoría eficaz. Escrito por un auditor experimentado con un amplio historial en TI y ciberseguridad, el manual ofrece información detallada, herramientas prácticas y avances detallados para ayudar a los lectores a auditar los sistemas de manera efectiva y garantizar el cumplimiento de las regulaciones.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Obtenga experiencia en la auditoría de entornos cloud como AWS, Azure y Google Cloud.
Aprende a realizar evaluaciones exhaustivas de riesgos para identificar posibles vulnerabilidades.
Auditoría de normas de cumplimiento, que abarcan el GDPR, HIPAA, SOX y más.
Desarrollar habilidades para auditar dispositivos de red, sistemas Linux/Windows y endpoints.
Comprender la progresión profesional en la auditoría de TI y herramientas y metodologías esenciales.

Autor(s)

Lewis Heuermann, con más de una década de experiencia de auditoría militar e informática, aporta una experiencia única a este manual de campo. Su enfoque combina la profundidad técnica con estrategias de acción. Lewis pretende salvar la brecha entre la comprensión fundamental y el conocimiento profesional avanzado, proporcionando un camino claro para el avance profesional en la auditoría de TI.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está dirigido a profesionales de TI nuevos para auditar o con experiencia profesional temprana, que buscan desarrollar habilidades de auditoría prácticas y factibles. Proporciona una base sólida mientras se intensifica en conceptos más avanzados, lo que lo hace adecuado para los estudiantes que buscan entrar o sobresalir en funciones de auditoría de TI y trabajar en infraestructuras complejas.

title: IT Security Risk Control Management: An Audit Preparation Plan
description:
Follow step-by-step guidance to craft a successful security program. You will identify with the paradoxes of information security and discover handy tools that hook security controls into business processes.

Information security is more than configuring firewalls, removing viruses, hacking machines, or setting passwords. Creating and promoting a successful security program requires skills in organizational consulting, diplomacy, change management, risk analysis, and out-of-the-box thinking.

What You'll Learn

Build a security program that will fit neatly into an organization and change dynamically to suit both the needs of the organization and survive constantly changing threats

Prepare for and pass such common audits as PCI-DSS, SSAE-16, and ISO 27001

Calibrate the scope, and customize security controls to fit into an organization's culture

Implement the most challenging processes, pointing out common pitfalls and distractions

Frame security and risk issues to be clear and actionable so that decision makers, technical personnel, and users will listen and value your advice

Who This Book Is For

IT professionals moving into the security field; new security managers, directors, project heads, and would-be CISOs; and security specialists from other disciplines moving into information security (e.g., former military security professionals, law enforcement professionals, and physical security professionals)
translatedDescription:
Siga la orientación paso a paso para elaborar un programa de seguridad exitoso. Se identificará con las paradojas de seguridad de la información y descubrirá herramientas útiles que enganchan los controles de seguridad en los procesos empresariales.

La seguridad de la información es más que configurar cortafuegos, eliminar virus, máquinas de piratería o establecer contraseñas. Crear y promover un programa de seguridad exitoso requiere habilidades en consultoría organizacional, diplomacia, gestión de cambios, análisis de riesgos y pensamiento fuera de la caja.

Lo que aprenderás

Construir un programa de seguridad que se adapte perfectamente a una organización y cambiar dinámicamente para satisfacer las necesidades de la organización y sobrevivir constantemente cambiando amenazas

Preparar y pasar auditorías comunes como PCI-DSS, SSAE-16 e ISO 27001

Calibrar el alcance y personalizar los controles de seguridad para encajar en la cultura de una organización

Implementar los procesos más difíciles, señalando las dificultades y distracciones comunes

Cuestiones de seguridad y riesgo marco para ser claras y factibles para que los responsables de decisiones, personal técnico y usuarios escuchen y valoren su consejo

Quién es este libro

Los profesionales de la tecnología de la información se trasladan al ámbito de la seguridad; los nuevos directores, directores, directores de proyectos, y los CISO; y los especialistas de seguridad de otras disciplinas que se trasladan a la seguridad de la información (por ejemplo, antiguos profesionales de la seguridad militar, profesionales de la aplicación de la ley y profesionales de la seguridad física)

title: Information Technology for Management, 11th Edition
description: Information technology is ever-changing, and that means that those who are working, or planning to work, in the field of IT management must always be learning. In the new edition of the acclaimed Information Technology for Management, the latest developments in the real world of IT management are covered in detail thanks to the input of IT managers and practitioners from top companies and organizations from around the world. Focusing on both the underlying technological developments in the field and the important business drivers performance, growth and sustainability—the text will help students explore and understand the vital importance of IT’s role vis-a-vis the three components of business performance improvement: people, processes, and technology. The book also features a blended learning approach that employs content that is presented visually, textually, and interactively to enable students with different learning styles to easily understand and retain information. Coverage of next technologies is up to date, including cutting-edged technologies, and case studies help to reinforce material in a way that few texts can.

title: Benefits Management: Delivering Value from IS & IT Investments
description: This book considers the topic of achieving value from IT from both theoretical and practical perspectives. It is based on extensive research which produced a comprehensive understanding and analysis of the issues involved and innovative new approaches that addressed those issues plus considerable practical application, in a wide range of organisations of the ideas, processes, tools and techniques that were developed. The book describes how IS/IT investments can be aligned accurately with organisational strategy and how the approach and ‘tool-kit’ can be used by business managers and IS/IT specialists to identify the benefits available from different types of investments in a variety of organisational contexts. It describes how business cases can be developed that enable  the benefits to be planned for and then realised through techniques and processes that overcome the organisational barriers that often prevent successful implementation. It also considers the strengths and limitations of existing methods, and shows how the approach can be integrated with best practice in the areas of project and change programme management. The book concludes by explaining how the key concepts in the approach have been extended and adapted to improve strategy development and decision making as well as an  organisation’s ability  to implement its strategy successfully.

El libro describe cómo las inversiones IS/IT se pueden alinear con precisión con la estrategia organizativa y cómo el enfoque y el "tool-kit" pueden ser utilizados por los gerentes de negocios y los especialistas de IS/IT para identificar los beneficios disponibles de diferentes tipos de inversiones en diversos contextos organizativos. Describe cómo se pueden desarrollar casos de negocios que permitan planificar y luego realizar los beneficios mediante técnicas y procesos que superen las barreras organizativas que a menudo impiden la implementación exitosa. title: Idea Stormers: How to Lead and Inspire Creative Breakthroughs
description:
How to solve critical business challenges by generating more and better ideas

Every organization needs a steady supply of fresh, relevant ideas, but managers can t just lock teams in a room with a mandate to brainstorm and hope for the best. Ideation is both a science and an art, and when group ideation processes are well-designed and well-facilitated, anyone can generate an abundance of creative, implementable options not to mention true breakthroughs for any business need. Identifies Mattimore s top ideation and innovation techniques (including brainwalking, finding inspiration in worst ideas, the unexpected effectiveness of wishing, and more) and lays the groundwork for you to invent successful processes of your own

Mattimore is a world-class expert on applied creativity and an innovation process consultant to over one-third of the Fortune 100 companies; he and his team have helped create and launch products and services worth over $3 billion in annual US retail sales

With a diverse range of tested methods, Idea Stormers is the indispensable guide for developing original, practical solutions to even the most intractable-seeming creative challenges.

title: IT Asset Management: A Pocket Survival Guide
description:
Implement Asset Management and reap the rewards!

IT Asset Management (ITAM) is the set of business practices that join financial, contractual and inventory functions to support life cycle management for elements found in the business environment, namely software and hardware.

Build your hardware asset listing first

Software is one of the most critical elements of information and communications technologies and most organisations have huge investments in software, whether internally developed or external procured. However, with a major objective of IT Asset Management usually being software licence control, it is essential to first establish a comprehensive hardware asset listing, as software is always installed on a device. Therefore, without knowing the extent of your hardware assets, you cannot be fully aware of what software is installed where, which could cause under-licensing issues.

Investment WILL deliver a return

Rewards to be gained from effectively implementing Asset Management are many and worthwhile. Although investment in an Asset Management project may not deliver an instant return, as the project starts to mature, opportunities to make savings will become apparent.

IT Asset Management: A Pocket Survival Guide is a quick reference style guide, addressing such serious issues with a fresh and pragmatic approach. Aimed at IT professionals who have been tasked with putting in place Asset Management disciplines, it first provides a commonsense introduction to the key processes outlined in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL®), before proceeding to explain the various milestones of an Asset Management project. It will guide the reader through

building a hardware asset listing
managing software asset inventory effectively, so compliance with software licences is achieved
how to get senior management buy-in
how to define, enforce and control procedures to manage IT assets more effectively for maximum savings.
"

Implementar la gestión de activos y recoger las recompensas!

Construya su lista de activos de hardware primero

El software es uno de los elementos más críticos de las tecnologías de la información y las comunicaciones y la mayoría de las organizaciones tienen enormes inversiones en software, ya sea desarrollada internamente o adquirida externamente. Sin embargo, con un objetivo importante de IT Asset Management generalmente siendo el control de licencias de software, es esencial establecer primero una lista completa de activos de hardware, ya que el software siempre está instalado en un dispositivo. Por lo tanto, sin saber la extensión de sus activos de hardware, no puede ser plenamente consciente de lo que el software está instalado donde, lo que podría causar problemas sub-licensantes.

La inversión entregará un retorno

Las recompensas que se obtienen de la aplicación efectiva de la gestión de activos son muchas y vale la pena. Aunque la inversión en un proyecto de gestión de activos puede no ofrecer un rendimiento instantáneo, ya que el proyecto comienza a madurar, las oportunidades de hacer ahorros serán evidentes.

IT Asset Management: A Pocket Survival Guide es una guía de estilo de referencia rápida, abordando cuestiones tan graves con un enfoque fresco y pragmático. title: Mastering ROS for Robotics Programming - Third Edition
description:
Mastering ROS for Robotics Programming is a comprehensive guide to developing smart and efficient robotic systems using the Robot Operating System (ROS). This book covers everything from fundamental concepts to advanced programming techniques, providing step-by-step guidance for practical applications such as motion planning and sensor integration.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the architecture and fundamental components of ROS to efficiently design robotic applications.
Implement complex robotic simulations using tools like Gazebo and CoppeliaSim for testing and development.
Apply autonomous navigation techniques with SLAM and AMCL packages to integrate intelligent movement.
Build custom robotic systems with hardware interfacing involving sensors, actuators, and I/O boards.
Use advanced tools like MoveIt! for motion planning and ROS-Industrial for integrating industrial robots.

Author(s)

Lentin Joseph and Jonathan Cacace are seasoned robotics professionals with years of experience in robotics and software design and a passion for teaching advanced robotics concepts. Drawing from their expertise, they focus on delivering practical knowledge, blending theory with real-world applications to help professionals master ROS.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for robotics engineers, software developers, or researchers who have a foundational understanding of ROS and Linux. Readers aiming to expand their expertise in robotic simulations, autonomous navigation, and integration of advanced robotic features will benefit greatly. Knowledge of programming concepts is required.

The IT Infrastructure Library® (ITIL) places the “best practices” in IT operations at your command. ITIL helps you make better technology choices, manages IT more effectively, and drives greater business value from all your IT investments. The core of ITIL is configuration management: the discipline of identifying, tracking, and controlling your IT environment’s diverse components to gain accurate and timely information for better decision-making.

Now, there’s a practical, start-to-finish guide to ITIL configuration management for every IT leader, manager, and practitioner. ITIL-certified architect and solutions provider Larry Klosterboer helps you establish a clear roadmap for success, customize standard processes to your unique needs, and avoid the pitfalls that stand in your way.

You’ll learn how to plan your implementation, deploy tools and processes, administer ongoing configuration management tasks, refine ITIL information, and leverage it for competitive advantage. Throughout, Klosterboer demystifies ITIL’s jargon, illuminates each technique with real-world advice and examples, and helps you focus on the specific techniques that offer maximum business value in your environment.

Coverage includes

Assessing your current configuration management maturity and setting goals for improvement

title: ITIL4 Direct, Plan and Improve: Reference and Study Guide
description: The ITIL 4 Direct, Plan and Improve (DPI) reference and revision guide is one of five ITIL 4 Managing Professional titles published by TSO, following on from the ITIL 4 Foundation revision guide. It provides a grounding in a set of principles, methods, and techniques to create a learning and improving environment. It covers the influence and impact of Agile and Lean ways of working and provides practical and strategic methods to plan and deliver continual improvement. Key topics include risk, decision-making, governance, continual improvement, assessing for improvement, developing a business case, organizational change management and communication, measuring and reporting, and value streams and practices. This pocket guide is an aid for revision and preparation for taking the ITIL 4 Managing Professional: DPI certification, and post-certification it is a quick useful reference. It summarizes key topics for exam preparation, includes key figures from the core guidance, provides an examination overview, tips for taking the exam and a summary table linking learning outcomes to references in the text and to core guidance.

Cubre la influencia y el impacto de las formas de trabajo ágiles y magras y ofrece métodos prácticos y estratégicos para planificar y mejorar continuamente. Entre los temas clave se incluyen el riesgo, la adopción de decisiones, la gobernanza, la mejora continua, la evaluación para la mejora, la elaboración de un caso empresarial, la gestión y comunicación del cambio organizativo, la medición y la presentación de informes y las corrientes y prácticas de valor. Esta guía de bolsillo es una ayuda para la revisión y preparación para tomar el ITIL 4 Managing Professional: DPI certificación, y post-certificación es una referencia útil rápida. En él se resumen los temas clave para la preparación del examen, se incluyen figuras clave de la orientación básica, se ofrece una visión general del examen, consejos para tomar el examen y una tabla sumaria que vincula los resultados del aprendizaje a las referencias en el texto y a la orientación básica.

title: Sustainable IT Playbook for Technology Leaders
description:
The book "Sustainable IT Playbook for Technology Leaders" focuses on addressing the urgent need for sustainable practices within the IT industry. With a clear structure divided into three parts, it helps readers understand the current environmental challenges, provides actionable methods to mitigate IT's environmental impact, and explains how to implement these techniques effectively. By the end, you'll be equipped to drive sustainable initiatives as an IT leader.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the environmental impact of IT and how to address it effectively.
Learn to build and implement a sustainable IT strategy using proven methods.
Optimize software and hardware for energy efficiency and resource conservation.
Engage stakeholders in developing and executing a sustainable IT plan.
Apply concepts such as circular economy and carbon footprint reduction to IT operations.

Author(s)

Niklas Sundberg, the author of this book, has significant experience as a technology leader, focusing on sustainable IT practices and their implementation. With his background in leading IT management and advocating for sustainability, Niklas brings practical knowledge and insights into the necessity and benefits of sustainable technology. His passion for this vital field emanates throughout his writing, making complex concepts accessible and actionable for technology leaders.

Who is it for?

This book is written for senior IT professionals and executives such as CIOs, CTOs, and CDOs who aim to incorporate sustainability into their organizational practices. It is suitable for those with some prior experience or knowledge of IT management and who are interested in leading their teams towards more environmentally-friendly technology operations. If you are a technology leader looking to make a positive impact through sustainability, this book is an invaluable resource.

title: Implementing World Class IT Strategy
description:
The actionable guide for driving organizational innovation through better IT strategy

With rare insight, expert technology strategist Peter High emphasizes the acute need for IT strategy to be developed not in a vacuum, but in concert with the broader organizational strategy. This approach focuses the development of technology tools and strategies in a way that is comprehensive in nature and designed with the concept of value in mind. The role of CIO is no longer "just" to manage IT strategy—instead, the successful executive will be firmly in tune with corporate strategy and a driver of a technology strategy that is woven into overall business objectives at the enterprise and business unit levels.

High makes use of case examples from leading companies to illustrate the various ways that IT infrastructure strategy can be developed, not just to fall in line with business strategy, but to actually drive that strategy in a meaningful way. His ideas are designed to provide real, actionable steps for CIOs that both increase the executive's value to the organization and unite business and IT in a manner that produces highly-successful outcomes.

Formulate clearer and better IT strategic plans
Weave IT strategy into business strategy at the corporate and business unit levels
Craft an infrastructure that aligns with C-suite strategy
Close the gap that exists between IT leaders and business leaders

While function, innovation, and design remain key elements to the development and management of IT infrastructure and operations, CIOs must now think beyond their primary purview and recognize the value their strategies and initiatives will create for the organization. With Implementing World Class IT Strategy, the roadmap to strategic IT excellence awaits.

Este enfoque centra el desarrollo de herramientas y estrategias tecnológicas de una manera que sea integral y diseñada con el concepto de valor en mente. El papel de CIO ya no es "justo" para gestionar la estrategia de TI, en lugar de ello, el ejecutivo exitoso estará firmemente en sintonía con la estrategia corporativa y un impulsor de una estrategia tecnológica que se teje en objetivos generales de negocio en los niveles de la empresa y la unidad empresarial.

Formular planes estratégicos más claros y mejores de TI
Lograr la estrategia de TI en la estrategia empresarial a nivel institucional y empresarial
Crear una infraestructura que se ajuste a la estrategia C-suite
Cerrar la brecha que existe entre los líderes de TI y los líderes empresariales

Si bien la función, la innovación y el diseño siguen siendo elementos clave para el desarrollo y la gestión de la infraestructura y las operaciones de TI, los CIO ahora deben pensar más allá de su ámbito primario y reconocer el valor que sus estrategias e iniciativas crearán para la organización. Con la implementación de la estrategia de TI de clase mundial, la hoja de ruta a la excelencia estratégica de TI espera.

title: Practical IT Service Management, 2nd Edition
description:
How can you ensure that IT problems do not damage your business?

IT is integral to modern organisations, and the way you manage it can make or break your business.

IT service management - not just for the IT director

It is not enough for the IT manager to understand the latest technical developments. For your company to succeed, everyone in the IT department must also understand their role in achieving overall business goals.

IT service management questions answered

Written in a friendly question-and-answer format, Practical ITSM explains how to set up a technical service management structure, using the best practice framework established by the latest version of the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL® 2011).

ITIL framework for structured ITSM

The ITIL system is the most widely adopted approach to technical IT service management worldwide. It shows technical support staff how to provide the efficient IT services that are vital to your company’s success. Learn how ITIL can help you to:

Protect your company’s reputation 

If you system goes down for any length of time, you might not be able to process an order or honour a contract. ITSM helps your business meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Safeguard vital information and recover from IT setbacks 

Without adequate IT service management you could risk losing vital information, like payroll, billing and sales data.

Retain momentum

With a structured IT service management in place, routine maintenance issues can be quickly resolved, minimising delays and improving productivity.

Read this book to see how ITIL can help your IT function support business goals.

About the author

Thejendra BS is the IT manager for a software development firm in Bangalore, and has over 20 years of experience in IT. Besides working in India, his career has also taken him to Saudi Arabia, Dubai, Bahrain and Australia. He has dealt with customers in many different areas of business, and has written many articles for websites such as techrepublic.com and drj.com. Visit www.thejendra.com for details of his other books and articles.

No es suficiente para que el gerente de TI entienda los últimos avances técnicos. Para que su empresa tenga éxito, todos en el departamento de TI también deben entender su papel en la consecución de los objetivos generales de negocio.

Protege la reputación de tu empresa

Salvaguardar la información vital y recuperarse de los contratiempos de TI

Sin una gestión adecuada de servicios de TI podría arriesgarse a perder información vital, como nómina, facturación y datos de ventas.

Retener el impulso

Con una gestión estructurada de servicios de TI en su lugar, las cuestiones de mantenimiento rutinario se pueden resolver rápidamente, minimizando las demoras y mejorando la productividad.

Lea este libro para ver cómo ITIL puede ayudar a su función de TI a apoyar los objetivos de negocio.

title: Implementing ITIL Change and Release Management
description:
The Business-Focused, Best-Practice Guide to Succeeding with ITIL Change and Release Management

ITIL® (Information Technology Infrastructure Library®) can help organizations streamline and integrate their operations, dramatically improving efficiency and delivering greater business value. For the first time, there's a comprehensive best-practice guide to succeeding with two of the most crucial and challenging parts of ITIL: change and release management.

Leading IBM® ITIL expert and author Larry Klosterboer shares solid expertise gained from real implementations across multiple industries. He helps you decide where to invest, avoid ITIL pitfalls, and build successful, long-term processes that deliver real return on investment. title: The Innovator's Solution, with a New Foreword
description:
The New York Times bestseller and seminal work on disruption—for every company seeking new growth.

Clayton Christensen's bestselling book, The Innovator's Dilemma, introduced the groundbreaking idea of disruptive innovation, revealing how even well-run companies can do everything right and yet still lose market leadership.

In The Innovator's Solution, Clayton Christensen and Michael Raynor expand on the idea of disruption, explaining how companies can and should become disruptors themselves. Now with a foreword by innovation expert Scott Anthony, this classic work shows just how timely and relevant these ideas continue to be in today's hyper-accelerated business environment and will help anyone trying to transform their business right now.

Christensen and Raynor give advice on the business decisions crucial to achieving truly disruptive growth and propose guidelines for developing your own disruptive growth engine. The authors identify the forces that cause managers to make bad decisions as they package and shape new ideas—and offer new frameworks to help create the right conditions, at the right time, for a disruption to succeed. This is a must-read for all senior managers and business leaders responsible for innovation and growth, as well as for members of their teams.

Based on in-depth research and theories tested in hundreds of companies across many industries, The Innovator's Solution is a necessary addition to any innovation library—and an essential read for entrepreneurs and business builders worldwide.

En la Solución del Innovador, Clayton Christensen y Michael Raynor amplían la idea de la perturbación, explicando cómo las empresas pueden y deben convertirse en disruptores. Ahora con un prefacio del experto en innovación Scott Anthony, este trabajo clásico muestra lo oportuno y relevante que estas ideas siguen siendo en el entorno empresarial hiperacelerado de hoy y ayudará a cualquiera que trate de transformar su negocio ahora mismo.

Christensen y Raynor dan consejos sobre las decisiones empresariales cruciales para lograr un crecimiento verdaderamente disruptivo y proponer directrices para desarrollar su propio motor de crecimiento disruptivo. Los autores identifican las fuerzas que hacen que los administradores tomen malas decisiones mientras empaquetan y dan forma a nuevas ideas, y ofrecen nuevos marcos para ayudar a crear las condiciones adecuadas, en el momento adecuado, para que una perturbación tenga éxito. Esto es imprescindible para todos los directivos y líderes empresariales responsables de la innovación y el crecimiento, así como para los miembros de sus equipos.

Basado en investigaciones profundas y teorías probadas en cientos de empresas de muchas industrias, La Solución del Innovador es una adición necesaria a cualquier biblioteca de innovación, y una lectura esencial para emprendedores y constructores de negocios en todo el mundo.

title: Demand-Driven Inventory Optimization and Replenishment
description:
Remove built-in supply chain weak points to more effectively balance supply and demand

Demand-Driven Inventory Optimization and Replenishment shows how companies can support supply chain metrics and business initiatives by removing the weak points built into their inventory systems. Beginning with a thorough examination of Just in Time, Efficient Consumer Response, and Collaborative Forecasting, Planning, and Replenishment, this book walks you through the mathematical shortcuts set up in your management system that prevent you from attaining supply chain excellence. This expanded second edition includes new coverage of inventory performance, business verticals, business initiatives, and metrics, alongside case studies that illustrate how optimized inventory and replenishment delivers results across retail, high-tech, men's clothing, and food sectors.

Inventory optimization allows you to avoid out-of-stock situations without impacting the bottom line with excessive inventory maintenance. By keeping just the right amount of inventory on hand, your company is better able to meet demand without sacrificing the cost-effectiveness of other supply chain strategies. The trick, however, is determining "just the right amount"—and this book provides the background and practical guidance you need to do just that.

Examine the major supply chain strategies of the last 30 years
Remove the shortcuts that prohibit supply chain excellence
Optimize your supply/demand balance in any vertical
Overcome systemic weaknesses to strengthen the bottom line

Inventory optimization is benefitting companies around the world, as exemplified here by case studies involving Matas, PWT, Wistron, and Amway. When inefficiencies are built into the system, it's only smart business to identify and remove them—and implement a new streamlined process that runs like a well-oiled machine. Demand-Driven Inventory Optimization and Replenishment is an essential resource for exceptional supply chain management.

Empezando con un examen minucioso de Just in Time, Efficient Consumer Response, and Collaborative Forecasting, Planning, and Replenishment, este libro le lleva a través de los atajos matemáticos establecidos en su sistema de gestión que le impide alcanzar la excelencia en la cadena de suministro. Esta segunda edición ampliada incluye nueva cobertura de rendimiento de inventario, verticales empresariales, iniciativas empresariales y métricas, junto con estudios de casos que ilustran cómo el inventario optimizado y la reposición ofrece resultados en los sectores minorista, de alta tecnología, ropa de hombre y alimentos.

La optimización de inventario le permite evitar situaciones fuera de existencia sin afectar la línea inferior con el mantenimiento excesivo de inventario. Manteniendo a mano la cantidad adecuada de inventario, su empresa es más capaz de satisfacer la demanda sin sacrificar la eficacia en función de los costos de otras estrategias de cadena de suministro. title: Assessing IT Projects to Ensure Successful Outcomes
description:
Assessing IT Projects to Ensure Successful Outcomes

Companies invest billions in technology projects each year, yet their success rates remain surprisingly low. Industry benchmarks suggest that only 15-20% of projects are completed on time and on budget.

Project failures can impair an organization’s capability as well as having significant commercial, compliance, and security ramifications, which in turn could cause reputational damage and long-term financial losses. It is therefore critical that projects meet their objectives. One way of ensuring that they do is to conduct assessments or audits at key points during their lifecycle.

Product overview

Assessing IT Projects to Ensure Successful Outcomes is a comprehensive reference guide that focuses on the assessment of IT projects. Organised into five main sections (Approach, Plan, Collect Information, Assess and Recommend, Package and Present), interspersed with case studies based on the author’s extensive experience delivering projects, the book provides exhaustive guidance on structuring and conducting an IT project assessment, from planning to presentation.

Assessing IT Projects to Ensure Successful Outcomes includes guidance on:

Types of assessments and project approaches, including the difference between a project and program assessment.Determining a suitable assessment approach, developing a plan, preparing inventories, and planning for logistics.Information collection and assessment, including identifying and addressing challenges and gaps.Project scoping, change management, schedule management, and cost management.Key roles and focus areas, including team responsibilities and necessary documents, for each project stage.Communication strategies to ensure all stakeholders are kept appropriately informed of a project’s progress.RAID (risks, actions, issues, decisions) management to address risks and issues that arise, actions that must be performed, and decisions that need to be made throughout the project’s lifecycle.Compliance with standard frameworks.Intangibles, such as adapting to company cultures and reacting to cultural conflicts, resource and team dynamics, perception and reputations, and morale.How to package and present an assessment’s findings and recommendations in a suitable manner.It also features a detailed summary section containing checklists for assessing all stages of projects – including typical roles on a project team, details of interview responsibilities by role, and a list of necessary project documents. This information can be used either reactively as an easy reference to assess projects, or proactively as a checklist of the considerations and activities required to plan and manage a project.

Although principally aimed at professionals who are assessing projects – such as internal auditors, framework auditors, project assessors, or external consultants – Assessing IT Projects to Ensure Successful Outcomes can also be used by project managers looking for a comprehensive view of approaches for managing projects, or as a means of preparing for an assessment of their project.

About the author

Kerry Wills is a consultant and a project manager who has worked on multi-million dollar technology projects for Fortune 500 companies since 1995, gaining essential experience as program manager, project manager, architect, developer, business analyst, and tester. This breadth of experience gives him a deep understanding of all facets of IT projects. He has planned and executed several large programs , as well as assessed and remediated several troubled programs .

Kerry Wills is also the author of Essential Project Management Skills and Applying Guiding Principles of Effective Program Delivery.

What do you have to do to make sure that IT headaches will not jeopardise your business?

Today, your IT system is no longer an optional extra. Instead, it is integral to how you demonstrate your core competences.

A stitch in time saves nine...

Getting to grips with IT service management is crucial for managers as well as for technical specialists.

It is not enough for the manager of an IT department to have an up-to-date knowledge of the latest technical developments. If you want your company to succeed, everyone in the IT department must also understand how their work is helping the company to achieve its overall business goals. You need to set up a system of IT service management before disaster strikes. If you want to avoid costly and damaging IT disasters, you should buy this book!

Protect your company's reputation IT service management ensures that a business can meet customer deadlines and expectations. If the computer system goes down and cannot be fixed quickly, your company might not be able to process an order or honour a contract.

Bounce back IT systems can be hit by a virus. But with IT service management, the company's system can get back on track as quickly as possible with the minimum of disruption.

title: The CIO Paradox: Battling the Contradictions of IT Leadership
description: Regardless of industry, most major companies are becoming technology companies. The successful management of information has become so critical to a company’s goals, that in many ways, now is the age of the CIO. Yet IT executives are besieged by a host of contradictions: bad technology can bring a company to its knees, but corporate boards rarely employ CIOs; CIOs must keep costs down at the very same time that they drive innovation. CIOs are focused on the future, while they are tethered by technology decisions made in the past. These contradictions form what Martha Heller calls The CIO Paradox, a set of conflicting forces that are deeply embedded in governance, staffing, executive expectations, and even corporate culture. Heller, who has spent more than 12 years working with the CIO community, offers guidance to CIOs on how to attack, reverse, or neutralize the paradoxical elements of the CIO role. Through interviews with a wide array of successful CIOs, The CIO Paradox helps readers level the playing field for IT success and get one step closer to bringing maximum value to their companies.
translatedDescription: Independientemente de la industria, la mayoría de las empresas principales se están convirtiendo en empresas tecnológicas. La gestión exitosa de la información se ha vuelto tan crítica a los objetivos de una empresa, que de muchas maneras, ahora es la edad del CIO. Sin embargo, los ejecutivos de TI son asediados por una serie de contradicciones: la tecnología mala puede poner una empresa en sus rodillas, pero las juntas corporativas rara vez emplean CIOs; CIOs debe mantener los costos al mismo tiempo que impulsan la innovación. Los CIO se centran en el futuro, mientras que están atestados por las decisiones tecnológicas tomadas en el pasado. Estas contradicciones forman lo que Martha Heller llama La CIO Paradox, un conjunto de fuerzas conflictivas que están profundamente arraigadas en la gobernanza, la dotación de personal, las expectativas ejecutivas e incluso la cultura corporativa. Heller, que ha pasado más de 12 años trabajando con la comunidad CIO, ofrece orientación a los CIO sobre cómo atacar, revertir o neutralizar los elementos paradójicos del papel CIO. A través de entrevistas con una amplia gama de CIOs exitosos, el CIO Paradox ayuda a los lectores a nivelar el campo de juego para el éxito de TI y a acercarse un paso más a traer el máximo valor a sus empresas.

title: CIOs at Work
description:
In CIOs at Work, noted author Ed Yourdon interviews many of the world's most influential chief information officers. You will gain insights from the first CIO of the USA, to a peek into the future from the CIO at Google, to the unique roll IT plays in testing Microsoft applications and much more.

Yourdon focuses on how his interviewees tackle the day-to-day work of managing information in their organizations while revealing much more: How they got there, how they manage and allocate resources, and how they interact with business units and assure that their companies take advantage of technologies and automation to make employees even more productive. Surveying a variety of unique corporations, you'll get a great sense of what can be done and what is being done now in organizations around the world. Don't miss this illuminating companion volume to the highly acclaimed Apress bestseller, Founders at Work by Jessica Livingston, and Peter Seibel's bestselling Coders at Work, also from Apress.

"Simply put, Ed Yourdon's CIOs at Work is a fascinating read. The author has managed to illuminate the real challenges confronting the Chief Information Officer. The technical expertise of his extraordinary interviewees and their personal insights into the changing role of technology in business are in no short supply. But, what really stands out–beyond the banter about "clouds," "agile development," – is the human dimension. More than anything else, the CIO is wrestling with profound issues: the proliferation of choices, the speed of change, the shorter attention spans of consumers, the "everyone's an expert" mindset, and the growing expectation for limitless and low cost computing resources that are as open and accessible as they are safe, secure and accurate. At last, the CIO has a human face, but also an enormous burden that can only be appreciated by reading Yourdon's probative interviews."

—Jon Toigo

Managing Principle, Toigo Partners International

What you'll learn

How many chief information officers from the world's leading corporations do their jobs and the skills they consider most essential for doing their jobs effectively

What technologies these CIOs think will be most important in the future

Interesting applications of technology used to increase productivity or profitability in today's leading organizations

The technology- and business-related challenges and opportunities that CIOs anticipate in the years ahead

Who this book is for

Anyone interested in how organizations are moving to use technology to make their companies more productive will learn a great deal from this book. CIOs at Work is especially useful to managers and IT personnel charged with increasing productivity and using automation to do so. Indeed, it's not just for aspiring CIOs, but also for project managers, management professionals, application developers, IT personnel and businesspeople who want to better understand the strategies their senior IT executives are following to make their organizations as productive and competitive as possible.
